# =============================================================================
# tessera-term: protected areas (SPA/EPA, DECSCA) and selective erase (DECSED/DECSEL)  (issue #95, wave 9)
# crates/tessera-term/tests/fixtures/protect_spec.txt   (spec-researcher output, edited by the implementer: see EDITS below)
#
# Same layout as csi_spec.txt / esctest_spec.txt (### ID / size / step / screen / cursor / pending_wrap / requests /
# scrollback), read by tests/spec/mod.rs `parse_fixture`. render_screen puts `|` AFTER the cursor's cell; a wide glyph is one
# character (its spacer is not drawn). Extra keys, ignored by that parser, that tests/protect.rs asserts by hand:
#     reply:   bytes Terminal must answer (DECRQSS / DA1), as in reports_spec.txt
#     pstate:  "<mode>/<pen>" after the whole script: mode = off|dec|iso (the terminal-wide protection mode), pen = 0|1
#              (the pen's PROTECTED bit). Mirrors xterm screen->protected_mode and (xw->flags & PROTECTED).
#     flags:   xterm-quirk | decision | control | negative | flips (an existing row in another fixture that must change)
#     source:  esctest2 file and test function when the row is a port
# Protection is invisible in render_screen, so every row proves it BEHAVIOURALLY: print protected text, run an erase, read
# what survived. `control` rows run the same erase without protection and prove the setup is not vacuous.
#
# EDITS (#95 brief, 2026-11-04): DECSERA is not implemented (descoped to #251, rectangular area operations), so section G
# (D01-D10) and the DECSERA rows K02/K03 are `#>` pending blocks below; K03 is now the SCORC variant of K01 (DECSEL), and
# Q09 no longer cites DECSERA. Rows are run by tests/protect.rs.
#
# DECISIONS (D-P*) are in spec-95-protect.md and ADR 0034; each row that depends on one names it. Summary: Tessera follows xterm exactly
# (one terminal-wide mode off|dec|iso, one per-cell bit), because xterm is the only oracle that passes esctest2.
#
# SOURCES
#   [XT]   xterm source, ThomasDickey/xterm-snapshots master (read 2026-11-04):
#            charproc.c CASE_DECSCA ~L5133, CASE_DECSED ~L5148, CASE_DECSEL ~L5154, CASE_SPA ~L5367, CASE_EPA ~L5374,
#                       CASE_ED/EL/ECH ~L3992..4008 (all pass OFF_PROTECT), CASE_DECSERA ~L5686 (needs vtXX_level >= 4),
#                       ReallyReset() ~L14428 (`bitclr(&xw->flags, PROTECTED); screen->protected_mode = OFF_PROTECT;`, soft AND full)
#            util.c     do_erase_char/do_erase_line/do_erase_display ~L2387..2500, ClearInLine2 ~L2163, ClearAbove/ClearBelow
#            screen.c   ScrnWipeRectangle ~L3095 (`IsProtected` is true only when protected_mode == DEC_PROTECT)
#            cursor.c   DECSC_FLAGS = ATTRIBUTES|ORIGIN|PROTECTED (L461); ptyx.h PROTECTED = AttrBIT(6), OFF/DEC/ISO_PROTECT = 0/1/2
#            misc.c     DECRQSS `"q` ~L4903: reply digit is 1 only if (protected_mode == DEC_PROTECT) && (flags & PROTECTED)
#            charproc.c DA1 ~L4181 `reply.a_param[count++] = 6; /* selective-erase */` for terminal_id >= 200
#   [CTL]  xterm ctlseqs https://invisible-island.net/xterm/ctlseqs/ctlseqs.html (HTTP 403 to the fetch tool on 2026-11-04;
#          the entries are quoted from the xterm source comments and the VT510 pages): ESC V SPA, ESC W EPA, C1 0x96/0x97,
#          CSI Ps " q DECSCA, CSI ? Ps J DECSED, CSI ? Ps K DECSEL, CSI Pt;Pl;Pb;Pr $ { DECSERA, DCS $ q " q ST DECRQSS.
#   [DEC]  VT510 RM https://vt100.net/docs/vt510-rm/DECSCA.html (Ps 0 default = erasable, 1 = not erasable, 2 = same as 0;
#          "does not effect visual character attributes set by SGR"), DECSED.html ("can only erase characters defined as
#          erasable by DECSCA"; works inside or outside the scrolling margins), DECSEL.html (same), DECSERA.html ("does not
#          change the active cursor position", "not affected by the page margins", coordinates affected by DECOM, "does not
#          change SGR visual attributes, DECSCA protection attributes, or line attributes"). "VT Level 4 mode only" on each.
#   [ECMA] ECMA-48 5th ed. https://ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-48_5th_edition_june_1991.pdf ; text read at
#          https://wezfurlong.org/ecma48/ (chapter 6 modes, 7 control functions). SPA = START OF GUARDED AREA (5th ed. name;
#          the ECMA-48 4th ed. / DEC name is "protected"), EPA = END OF GUARDED AREA. ED/EL/ECH: "Whether protected areas are
#          erased, or unprotected areas only, depends on the setting of the ERASURE MODE" (ERM, 6.2.3: RESET = PROTECT = only
#          unprotected data are erased, SET = ALL; initial state implementation-defined). ICH/DCH/IL/DL do not mention
#          protection. NB xterm implements ISO protection as if ERM were permanently RESET, and has no ERM (CSI 6 h/l).
#   [E2]   esctest2 https://github.com/ThomasDickey/esctest2 esctest/tests/{ed,el,ech,decsed,decsel,decsera,decstr,s8c1t,
#          save_restore_cursor}.py (raw files read 2026-11-04). decsca.py does not exist: DECSCA is exercised through the rest.
#   [DEC070] DEC STD 070 is not online; xterm cites it for DECSC/DECRC contents (cursor.c comment L440..455).
#   Divergence notes only: VTE has no SPA/EPA/DECSCA (drops them); kitty implements none; WezTerm parses DECSCA/DECSED/DECSEL
#   but erases regardless (grid has no protected bit); iTerm2 implements none (esctest2 marks every test a knownBug).
#
# CELL-LEVEL MODEL ASSUMED BY EVERY ROW (xterm): the pen has one PROTECTED bit; printing copies it into the cell (so it travels with
# the cell through DCH/ICH/IL/DL/scroll/reflow/alt-screen); blank cells made by erase/insert never carry it. The terminal has one
# mode off|dec|iso: SPA => iso, DECSCA (any Ps) => dec, EPA / DECSCA 0 only clear the pen bit (DECSCA 0 DOES still set dec).
# Erase honours the cell bit iff: ED/EL/ECH: mode == iso. DECSED/DECSEL: mode != off. (xterm's DECSERA: mode == dec; #251.)
# =============================================================================

# ============================================================================ A. ISO (SPA/EPA): ED, EL, ECH honour it

### P01_ed0_respects_iso_protection
size: 3x10
step: feed ab\eVc\eW\e[1;1H\e[J
source: esctest2 ed.py test_ED_respectsISOProtection
cite: [E2] ed.py; [ECMA] ED + ERM (reset = PROTECT); [XT] CASE_ED -> do_erase_display(.., OFF_PROTECT), mode iso => ClearInLine skips PROTECTED cells (ED 0 at 1;1 is turned into ED 2 by xterm, same result)
note: 'c' was written between SPA and EPA, so it survives; 'a' and 'b' are erased.

### P11_ech_over_a_protected_cell_disarms_the_pending_wrap
size: 3x10
step: feed \eVabcdefghij\eW\e[X
cite: Tessera decision (brief "Pending wrap", ADR 0034): ECH and EL disarm a pending wrap even when every cell of the range is protected; xterm's ClearInLine2 returns before ResetWrap there (a listed deviation)
note: 'j' on the last column is protected and the wrap is pending; ECH 1 erases nothing and the next character would print over column 10, not wrap.
screen:
>abcdefghij|
>
>

note: every cell is protected and stays, but row 1 no longer continues onto row 2 (no trailing `\`): a copy or a re-wrap treats them as two lines.

# ============================================================================ D. The terminal-wide mode (D-P1): who wins

### M01_decsca0_after_spa_switches_to_dec_and_ech_stops_honouring
size: 3x10
step: feed ab\eVc\eW\e[0"q\e[1;1H\e[3X
cite: [XT] CASE_DECSCA sets protected_mode = DEC_PROTECT for every Ps including 0; ECH asks OFF_PROTECT, so a DEC-mode terminal ignores the (ISO-written) bit
note: THE xterm one-mode consequence: the cell bit does not remember whether SPA or DECSCA wrote it. Recommend replicating (D-P1).
screen:
> |
>
>
cursor: (0,0)
pending_wrap: false
requests: []
scrollback: len=0

#> ============================================================================ Pending: DECSERA (#251)
#> DECSERA (`CSI Pt;Pl;Pb;Pr $ {`) needs rectangle infrastructure Tessera does not have yet (DECERA/DECFRA/DECCRA, `$`
#> rectangle parsing with defaults, clamping, DECOM and validation, the level-4 gate). These rows move to #251 ("term:
#> rectangular area operations DECERA, DECFRA, DECCRA, DECSERA") unchanged; lift them into the cases there. D-P7 (DECSERA
#> keeps colours, D10) moves with them. Today DECSERA is an ignored CSI with an intermediate.
#>
#> # ============================================================================ G. DECSERA
#>
#> # prepare (4x5): odd rows protected: aaaaa / bbbbb unprotected / ccccc protected / ddddd unprotected; cursor then moved to 2;3
#>

#> cite: [XT] CASE_DECSERA `if (screen->vtXX_level >= 4)`; Tessera's level gate for DECLRMM/DECSLRM uses the same pattern (ADR 0028)
#> note: DECSCL 62 is a soft reset and leaves the screen and cursor alone. DECSED/DECSEL/DECSCA are NOT level-gated in xterm.
#> screen:
#> >abc|
#> >
#> >
#> cursor: (0,3)
#> pending_wrap: false
#> requests: []
#> scrollback: len=0
#> flags: decision
#>
#> ### D10_decsera_keeps_sgr_attributes_and_the_protection_bit_of_what_stays
#> size: 3x10
#> step: feed \e[41mabc\e[0m\e[1;1;1;3${
#> cite: [DEC] DECSERA "does not change SGR visual attributes, DECSCA protection attributes, or line attributes"; [XT] ScrnWipeRectangle `Clear1Cell` leaves attribs (colour) untouched, unlike ED/EL which use the current background (BCE)
#> note: the erased cells keep bg=red from the printed text. pen text is sgr_spec.txt canonical form.
#> screen:
#> >    |
#> >
#> >
#> cursor: (0,3)
#> pending_wrap: false
#> requests: []
#> scrollback: len=0
#> attr: (0,0)-(0,2) fg=- bg=1 ul=- us=none flags=-
#> flags: decision
#>
#> ### K02_decrc_protection_with_decsera
#> size: 3x10
#> step: feed \e[1"q\e7\e[0"q\e8a\e[1;1;1;1${
#> source: esctest2 save_restore_cursor.py test_SaveRestoreCursor_Protection (the original, DECSERA form)
#> cite: [E2] save_restore_cursor.py; [XT] CASE_DECSERA (level >= 4), mode dec so the protected 'a' survives
#> screen:
#> >a |
#> >
#> >
#> cursor: (0,1)
#> pending_wrap: false
#> requests: []
#> scrollback: len=0
#> pstate: dec/1

#> ### K03b_scorc_protection_with_decsera
#> size: 3x10
#> step: feed \e[1"q\e[s\e[0"q\e[ua\e[1;1;1;1${
#> source: esctest2 scorc.py via save_restore_cursor.py test_SaveRestoreCursor_Protection (E_SCORC_saveRestoreCursor_protection; DECSERA form like the original)
#> cite: [E2] scorc.py inherits SaveRestoreCursorTests; [XT] SCOSC/SCORC share CursorSave/CursorRestore with DECSC/DECRC
#> screen:
#> >a |
#> >
#> >
#> cursor: (0,1)
#> pending_wrap: false
#> requests: []
#> scrollback: len=0

#> Not covered by rows here (xterm behaviour noted in spec-95-protect.md and ADR 0034):
#>   - DECERA/DECFRA/DECCRA are not implemented in Tessera at all. xterm's DECERA ignores protection and DECFRA/DECERA stamp the
#>     pen's PROTECTED bit onto the new blanks (ScrnFillRectangle uses xw->flags). If those ever land, the rows go with them.
#>   - resize/reflow of a protected soft-wrapped line must keep the bit on each cell: tests/protect.rs protection_survives_reflow.
#>   - pending-wrap on a fully protected ECH/EL range: xterm does not call ResetWrap (ClearInLine2 returns before it). Tessera
#>     always disarms; not asserted.
#>   - xterm's do_erase_display(2) resets the mode to OFF when the erase found no protected cell left (D-P5): NOT replicated.
